propositions: The module-size gate step aborts with exit 1 when the allowlist contains only comments/whitespace because grep returns exit 1 on no-match and pipefail+set -e propagates it before the over-cap check runs.
The fix guards the grep command with '|| true' so a no-match does not abort the step, allowing the gate to complete and report OK when the allowlist is empty and no files are over-cap.
Both workflow files (gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml) contain an identical 'listed=' line that must be updated in the same way to handle the drained allowlist.
The gate must still fail (exit 1) when a non-allow-listed file exceeds 800 LOC, preserving correctness for the non-empty allowlist case.
The parity test must remain passing to ensure the 'Module-size gate' step is present in both workflows.
